metadata.title: Audit Plan
metadata.description: Prepare artifacts and audit trails for supplier compliance reviews.

steps.speaker: Audit Lead
steps.message: Kick off a due diligence pack for our top ten suppliers and include SLA breach evidence.

steps.speaker: Cockpit Agent
steps.message: Starting the pack now. I"ll assemble contracts, delivery scores, and outstanding penalties.

steps.message: Send me a quick status update once you finish the sampling run.

steps.message: Will do. I"ll also attach a CSV export so you can share it with the auditors.
